accounting_unit: sum of prompt and output tokens including one-token prompt preflights, all generation, deduplication, ranking, retries; shared preparation charged to each selection arm
proposal_basis: cost-limited design using the existing temporary development ceiling; not an observed successful-workflow maximum or a guarantee of completion

proposed_related_limits.status: unapproved design choices; 2048-token output and 8192-token context not runtime-probed by saved 32-token verification

rationale: A fixed resource limit defines a valid cost-constrained estimand without requiring every arm to complete.
2048 output tokens provide more room than the 512-token development setting for JSON and six hypotheses, but adequacy is unmeasured.
The 8192-token context proposal covers each call admitted by the shared total budget; metadata alone does not verify runtime behavior.
required_approval_terms: Accept budget-exhaustion and invalid/incomplete outputs as retained failures under an approved denominator rule.
Accept that repeated evidence prompts charge selection arms more and may exhaust their budget.
Approve decoding, retry, missingness and related limits together; no silent adoption from this artifact.
optional_development_check: One checkpointed DEVELOPMENT row can test these exact proposed settings if desired; no ten-row completion prerequisite. Existing runner remains at its historical 512 output tokens and is not evidence for the proposed 2048 setting.
alternatives: Choose a different cost ceiling prospectively with rationale.
Use saved uncensored complete DEVELOPMENT envelopes if supplied; report censored cells separately.
